lines: Liquidity7 remains robust at $8.7bn, and the Company’s positive free cash flow outlook for 2026 and beyond remains unchanged.

Strategic growth investments target higher-margin products and attractive returns, supporting structurally higher EBITDA, free cash flow and ROCE. 2026 capex guidance remains unchanged at $4.5bn-$5.0bn, including $1.7bn-$1.9bn of strategic capex.
Strategic projects are expected to increase EBITDA potential by ~$1.8 billion from 2026 and beyond.

The 2026 contribution from strategic projects is now expected to be ~$0.5 billion (previously guided at $0.7 billion), reflecting a lower year-on-year contribution from Liberia due to shipment volumes of ~16Mt (vs. ~18Mt previously guided) and higher freight rates.
